Bug_Title: Non-serializable objects should not be stored in "javax.servlet.http.HttpSession" instances
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where a non-serializable object (Address) is stored in an HttpSession. This can lead to serialization failures when the HttpSession is passivated and later activated.
